content: {"summary":"Customers report that orders are frequently mis‑prepared, such as burgers with incorrect toppings and drinks served without requested ingredients [tk_2441985]. Many orders are cancelled abruptly without explanation, leaving staff and customers frustrated [tk_2420935][tk_2412729]. Delivery times are excessively long, with customers chasing drivers for over an hour [tk_2388093]. Duplicate orders and unclear vendor handling cause billing confusion [tk_2424832]."}
